paper_title: Thermal Simulation of a CPU Based on Model Order Reduction

evidence.value: Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) with Galerkin projection method
CPU chip with 3D structure, device layer with functional units A, B, and C
Three uniform power pulses applied to functional units A, B, and C with period of 3.333μs, representing average over 10k cycles at 3 GHz
Adiabatic boundary conditions on chip surfaces except bottom of substrate where Robin boundary condition is used with ambient temperature of 0°C

POD model with 3 modes provides good accuracy compared to FEniCS simulation; 5 modes provide excellent agreement with FEniCS results; reduction in numerical degrees of freedom by more than 4 orders of magnitude

missing_for_exact_replication: Thermal properties (thermal conductivity, density, specific heat capacity) of materials
Specific power values for each functional unit
Detailed layer structure and material composition
Complete floorplan with precise functional unit locations and sizes
